SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.status AS "status", o.created_at AS "createTime",
SUM(i.price * i.count) AS "totalPrice", SUM(i.count) AS "totalCount",
-- PostgreSQL 聚合函数，生成 JSONB/JSON 数组 json_agg( json_build_object( 'id', i.id, 'goodsId', p.id, 'title', p.title, 'cover', p.cover, 'count', i.count, 'price', i.price ) ) AS goods
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.goods_id = p.id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
AND o.status = #{status}
AND ( o.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.title ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') )
GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.created_at
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

select o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status, o.created_at as createTime, o.total_price as totalPrice, o.total_count as totalCount, o.receiver_name as name, o.receiver_phone as phone, o.receiver_address as location, o.shipped, o.closed, json_agg( json_build_object( 'id',i.id, 'price',p.price, 'goodsId',i.goods_id, 'title',p.title, 'cover',p.cover, 'count',i.count ) ) as goods
from orders o left join order_items i on o.id = i.order_id left join products p on i.goods_id = p.id where o.id=#{id} group by o.id, o.order_no, o.status, o.created_at, o.total_price, o.total_price, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address
